<!-- pr-reviewer: 6761845ff5228d617bfb3190b269ce537a1f9838 -->
**Needs a merge with main before it can be flagged ready** (one code conflict, trivial; no other blockers found).

**Conflict** with current main (after #408 and #410 landed): `crates/app/src/rest/across.rs` ~line 204, `carried_body_bounds`. Main's #410 follow-up (3ae854b) changed its return to `Result<Option<(Bounds, Dexel)>, String>` and returns the grid; this PR changed the body to read `carried_body(...)`. Resolution I used locally: signature from main, `let body = carried_body(world, chain, min_r, false)?; let dex = &body.dex;`, and `then_some(((lo, hi), dex.clone()))`. With that it compiles and every suite below passes. The author should merge main, resolve the same way, and re-gate.

**What looks good**
- Cache key is complete. The stock-source pick from #408 (`Entry::NewBlock` / Own vs FromPrevious) is covered indirectly but correctly: `chain_of` consults `carry::entry`, so the pick decides where the chain starts and which turns it has; origin stock, turns and every cutting op's moves/tool are hashed, so any pick change that alters the body changes the key. Machine kind, suppression and part alignment/flip also act through the chain or turns. Lattice radius and through_consumer are in the key.
- Content-addressed, so the per-thread cache cannot serve a different document's body (undo across open, several documents, MCP all just miss); clearing on open and new world is memory hygiene. Bounded to 4 per thread. Unhashable stock is never cached.
- Lathe/mill-turn carry is refused by name through one constant in `carry_turn`/`entry`; generation and the rest chain both use it.
- No unwrap/expect/panic in the new modules; float-to-index casts go through clamps; provenance lines present; new files well under 400 lines.

**Local results (PR trial-merged with origin/main 1a882e5 plus the resolution above)**
| suite | result |
|---|---|
| app lib | 95 passed |
| carried_fixtures_cache | 5 passed |
| carried_verify | 8 passed |
| setup_carry | 5 passed |
| rest_across_setups | 7 passed |
| fixtures | 14 passed |
| stock_sim_document | 9 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| golden_cl | 23 passed |
| lathe_field_sim | 6 passed |
| setup_relative | 8 passed |
| commands_undo | 32 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. Merge main and resolve `rest/across.rs` (`carried_body_bounds`) as above; re-gate.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Fixture sampling gap: a column counts only if its centre is strictly inside the footprint. The cell is `tool_r/8` or span/1023, so the miss is under about half a cell (typically 0.1-0.3 mm). A fixture narrower than one cell containing no column centre would never be flagged, but that is not realistic for workholding. Inflating by half a cell would flag legitimate face contact, so I accept the documented trade-off. A cheap tightening if wanted: when a footprint contains no centre, test the nearest column.
- Worker threads keep up to 4 cached bodies until the thread ends (clear only runs on the calling thread); bounded, not a leak.
- The silent `continue` on a refused `entered_body` relies on generation refusing that op; true today.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: d364fb5693bfa8e928684d87c0d205532cd8a674 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (delta review of d364fb5 over 6761845)

**What looks good**
- Merge with main is clean (branch already contains origin/main; no conflicts).
- `carried_body_bounds` resolution keeps both sides: #410's `(Bounds, Dexel)` signature, the body read from the carried-body cache, `dex.clone()` of the same `body.dex` the old `carried_grid` returned. Errors still propagate with `?` (same fallback as before). `carried_grid` is now a thin view of the cached body.
- Narrow-fixture rule in `fixture_carried.rs::penetration` is purely additive: the centre-inside loop is unchanged; only when no column centre falls inside does the column under the footprint centre get judged (`dex.col` is an `Option`, no cast risk). It can only add refusals, never remove one. Pinned by `a_fixture_narrower_than_a_cell_is_judged_by_the_column_under_it`.
- Cache key still digests the origin setup's stock, lattice radius, every chain turn and cutting atom; the chain itself comes from `chain_of`/`carry::entry`, so #408's stock-source pick (Clip/NewBlock break the chain) decides what is keyed. No unwrap/expect/panic in the new modules.

**Local results (merged with main, own target dir)**
- app lib 95 pass; carried_fixtures_cache 6; carried_verify 8; setup_carry 5; rest_across_setups 7; fixtures 14; stock_sim_document 9; posting 17; golden_cl 23; setup_stock_source 6 - all pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Requested before merge**: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
